recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片免疫染色（抗原未標示）中，棕色陽性細胞呈線狀與小群散布於細胞密度中高的骨髓內，陰性細胞仍佔多數；需對照抗體種類判讀。
features: Moderately to highly cellular marrow between trabeculae
Brown-positive cells scattered singly, in small clusters and in linear streaks
Majority of cells negative with hematoxylin counterstain
Specific antigen not indicated in the image
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow core biopsy (antigen not specified) shows a cellular marrow with brown-positive cells scattered singly, in small clusters and in linear streaks among a predominantly negative population. Fat spaces are partly preserved and trabeculae are unremarkable. Interpretation depends on the antibody applied; in severe congenital neutropenia, such stains are used to demonstrate the distribution of myeloid precursors and the relative lack of mature neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Normal marrow shows the expected proportion of mature myeloid cells on H&E and aspirate differential.
Neoplastic infiltrates form cohesive aggregates or sheets of positive or negative cells rather than a dispersed pattern.
